title: grevillea manglesii subsp. dissectifolia
intro: Grevillea manglesii subsp. dissectifolia, commonly known as the Mountain Devil, is a species of flowering plant in the protea family. Traditionally used in Australian traditional medicine, this plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Grevillea manglesii subsp. dissectifolia include anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which may help relieve congestion and promote mucus production. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
